findings.message: The R1-R3 runtime evidence was recorded against older product fingerprints, not the current one (b1d615938b71677059fec00f5682b10b75d261e31bc62321aaae1ce551b10a48). The R3-test report (b2123188...) and the R3-api report (0aa6c35e...) are at e3aecac831f24315d0bfb3dc999e1b2fba97019d02231aecb8ed5409934bba53. The R2 review is at 9e15d32e..., and the R1 review is at 0abf58d1.... Only the R4 evidence is at the current product. Before final verify, run all eight checks again against the current product: R1-test/api, R2-test/api, R3-test/api and R4-test/api. Affected executions: c6861861-11d1-4784-88b9-33ddc6c31450 (R1, R2) and 9a1f3c52-7d44-4e0b-b1d6-2f5a8c0e7b11 (R3, R4).

The HTTP part of the shared adapter (/home/user/Claude-enhancement-system/examples/api-check.mjs) only serves add(5,3) and greet(' Ada '). It only checks for status 200 and a numeric sum. Its real HTTP call therefore never exercises divide or clamp, so for R2 and R4 the api check is backed only by its direct function assertions. The mission does not require a server owned by the product, so this matches architecture assumption A5. It must not be addressed by editing the acceptance adapter (P5). If the final auditor decides a product-owned endpoint is needed, it should be added as a new backlog task.

Nothing yet independently proves P5 (acceptance tests not weakened). The adapter I read still contains the full assertions for R1-R4 and the contract check commands point at it unchanged. However, I had only read-only file tools, so I did not compare it with git history. The final review or audit should confirm that the common repo's examples/api-check.mjs and contract.json have no diff from their original revision.

Final-stage work has not been done yet: the final Sonnet review, the Opus final audit against the current product, contract and executions, live model-routing import for every stage (routing.json lists runtime records but I did not check model identity), parent-only termination proof, state end, and verify.mjs. current-task.json shows stage PLAN with active=true and sprint_task_id R4, and all backlog items are PASS. The coordinator should move to the final stages and not re-plan R4.

The R3 review noted that resume state was RETAINED_IMPLEMENTATION with observe_required=true and that the reviewer did not inspect the partial diff through operation receipts. The current app.mjs shows a correct, single implementation of greet with no duplicated edits. Still, the final audit should confirm that the R3 implement operation receipt is completed and not left unobserved.
